svg.style: max-width: 980px; background-color: transparent; font-family: 'trebuchet ms', verdana, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px;
svg.title: One scanned heading, and the 1907 Espagnole tree before and after the guard
svg.desc: Top, the heading of entry 22 as the 1907 scan reads it, 22 em-dash BROWN SAUCE OR ESPAQNOLE, with the Q drawn in orange, beside the same heading in the 1909 transcription, which reads ESPAGNOLE. Below, two columns. Left, before: the only candidate for the mother espagnole is LENTEN ESPAGNOLE, entry 24 at line 1795, crowned because it is first in source order, and the tree heads on LENTEN ESPAGNOLE with HALF GLAZE and its nine derivatives and the two Poivrade sauces beneath it. Right, after: that candidate is struck out because its opening paragraph states Espagnole, no candidate is left, the mother stays uncatalogued, and the tree heads on the bare concept espagnole with LENTEN ESPAGNOLE demoted to a child alongside the others. Caption: the guard removed one candidate, and one line of JSON changed.
svg.text: the heading of entry 22, as each witness carries it
a mother takes the first preparation answering to its name
and never one whose opening paragraph states that mother
crowned: the only run match, so nothing to rank
rejected: its opening states Espagnole. None left.
twelve preparations under a Lenten sauce
The guard removed one candidate in this witness. The 1907 catalogue gained one derived sauce, 140 / 50 / 90 became 140 / 51 / 89,
and the 1909 catalogue came out byte-identical. No repair was made to the heading: the scan still reads ESPAQNOLE.
